usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun-web-vbsbhh7lea-uc.a.run.app/api/v1/chat/completions with JSON body {model, messages, max_tokens?, temperature?, stream?}
usage.outputShape: body.choices[0].message.content (assistant text); token usage at body.usage.total_tokens; OpenAI chat.completion shape
quirks: Registry surface lists method GET, but the endpoint actually requires POST with a JSON body — GET will not work; call it as POST.
OpenAI-compatible: required fields are 'model' and 'messages'. 'model' must be one of the enum IDs (e.g. openai/gpt-4o-mini, anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5).
Pricing is token-based/dynamic; the $0.0010 surface price is a floor. Larger prompts/completions cost more, so a cheap model + small max_tokens keeps cost low.
x402 USDC on Base, no API key. Response model field echoes the resolved upstream model (e.g. gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18).
usage.guide: Send a POST (not GET) to https://blockrun-web-vbsbhh7lea-uc.a.run.app/api/v1/chat/completions with a JSON body {"model": "<one of the enum model IDs>", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}, optionally max_tokens/temperature/stream. Pay via x402 USDC on Base; no API key. Read the assistant reply at body.choices[0].message.content and token usage at body.usage. Cost is token-based and dynamic (min ~$0.001), so use a cheap model and small max_tokens to control spend.
